description: Source file for campaign management in Wesnoth, including functions for campaign info retrieval, setting, listing available campaigns, encoding/decoding binary data, archiving/unarchiving campaigns, and validating campaign names.

methods.name: campaign_dir
methods.description: Returns the path to the campaigns directory.

methods.name: setup_dirs
methods.description: Creates necessary directories for campaign data.

methods.name: get_campaign_info
methods.description: Loads campaign configuration from a file.

methods.name: set_campaign_info
methods.description: Saves campaign configuration to a file.

methods.name: available_campaigns
methods.description: Lists available campaigns based on directory contents.

methods.name: encode_binary
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a string with escaping.

methods.name: unencode_binary
methods.description: Decodes escaped string back into binary data.

methods.name: archive_file
methods.description: Archives a single file into a config structure.

methods.name: archive_dir
methods.description: Recursively archives a directory into a config structure.

methods.name: archive_campaign
methods.description: Archives an entire campaign into a config structure.

methods.name: unarchive_file
methods.description: Restores a file from a config structure.

methods.name: unarchive_dir
methods.description: Recursively restores a directory from a config structure.

methods.name: unarchive_campaign
methods.description: Restores a campaign from a config structure.

methods.name: two_dots
methods.description: Helper function to detect consecutive dots.

methods.name: check_names_legal
methods.description: Checks legality of all campaign directory names.
